comment: GENERATED by tools/generate-grammar.ts from src/generated/*.ts (NTT /gmlapi dump, game_version 100034) and src/tables/*.ts. Do not edit; run `pnpm gen`. This is the modern NTGML dialect (.ntgml); see NTGML-SPEC.md section 1.
name: NTGML

patterns.comment: GMS1-style documentation comment; NTGML has no JSDoc tags (spec 2.4).
patterns.name: comment.line.documentation.ntgml

patterns.comment: A #define whose name is a reserved mod event (spec 8.1).
patterns.name: meta.preprocessor.define.ntgml

define-arguments.comment: Named `#define` arguments. Ends at the line break so a stray `(` cannot run away.

macro.comment: `#macro name value` and `#macro config:name value`; a trailing \ continues the body.
macro.name: meta.preprocessor.macro.ntgml

pragma.comment: `#pragma` is matched wherever a statement can start, not only at the top of the file: `fast`, `not_fast` and `no_using` are statements inside a function body (spec 2.8). A word outside the nine known pragmas is one the loader rejects.
pragma.name: meta.preprocessor.pragma.ntgml

region.comment: Editor-side folding the game parses and ignores (spec 2.8).

string-template.comment: Backtick template string: `${expr}` nests, bare `$ident` also interpolates.
string-template.name: string.template.ntgml

nested-braces.comment: Keeps a `{ }` inside an interpolation from ending it early.

string-quote-template.comment: GM2023-style template string, modern dialect only (spec 2.3).
string-quote-template.name: string.quoted.template.ntgml

string-single.comment: Legal in the legacy dialect; the modern parser likely rejects it (spec 2.3).
string-single.name: string.quoted.single.ntgml

patterns.comment: A `function` whose name is a reserved mod event (spec 8.1).
patterns.name: meta.function.ntgml

patterns.comment: Named declaration, and the anonymous `function(...)` literal.
patterns.name: meta.function.ntgml

patterns.comment: The lookbehind above cannot cross a line break, so a parameter list split over several lines needs its own rule.

nested-parens.comment: Keeps a call inside a default argument from closing the parameter list.

patterns.comment: Parsed specially without being a lexer keyword (spec 2.5).
patterns.name: support.function.fork.ntgml

patterns.comment: Parsed specially without being a lexer keyword (spec 2.5).
patterns.name: support.function.once.ntgml

member-access.comment: `inst.name` is a field of that instance, not the built-in of the same name - `global.frac` is not `frac`. The call form `inst.alarm_set(0, 30)` is left to the function rules, because those really are API methods. A call on a user-defined method (`c.bump()`, `Player.my_thing(1)`) therefore gets no scope at all, since only API names are in the tables, while reading the same field without calling it gets `variable.other.member`.

custom-fields.comment: Callback fields of the Custom* object family, only after a `.` (spec 8.2).

patterns.comment: Functions annotated `:name(...)` in api.gml: they act on `self`.
patterns.name: support.function.self.ntgml

assets.comment: Asset names from the dump (spec 6). Object names have no prefix.

patterns.comment: DS and struct accessors; `[$ key` is modern only (spec 2.7).
